discussions.title: 自定义 Agent Preset 的 name/description 无法随界面语言本地化

en.headline: 13 own commits plus 22 automated commits across three repositories
en.summary: **13 own commits** were made across `sogeisetsu/subagent-preset-select` and `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`, plus 22 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. In `sogeisetsu/subagent-preset-select`, 8 commits added Chinese roster descriptions, renamed the package to `dsh-subagent-preset-select`, flattened the bundle to the repository root, split preset rows into subpath plugins, restored shipped skill-path resolution in the lead preset, and added Chinese READMEs, language metadata, and project instructions. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`, 5 commits documented DSH timing metrics, automated task mechanisms and archiving boundaries, a HungerG Free pelican riding evaluation sample, `dsh web` persistent startup alongside Desktop, and ACL propagation experiments with their missed-fix root cause. No pull requests, issues, or reviews were recorded. The user commented in the existing `deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness` discussion #3610, “自定义 Agent Preset 的 name/description 无法随界面语言本地化”, which had 2 comments.

zh.headline: 13 次本人提交，另有 22 次自动提交，分布在三个仓库
zh.summary: **13 次本人提交**分布在 `sogeisetsu/subagent-preset-select` 和 `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`，另有 22 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 自动提交。在 `sogeisetsu/subagent-preset-select` 的 8 次提交中，新增了中文名册描述，将包重命名为 `dsh-subagent-preset-select`，把 bundle 平铺到仓库根目录，将预设行拆分为子路径插件，恢复 lead 预设随包发布的 skill 路径解析，并补充中文 README、语言元数据和项目说明。在 `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 的 5 次提交中，记录了 DSH 统计口径、自动化任务机制与归档边界、HungerG Free 鹈鹕骑行评估样例、`dsh web` 常驻启动与 Desktop 共存，以及 ACL 传播实验与漏修根因。当天没有 PR、issue 或 review 记录。用户参与了 `deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness` 已有讨论 #3610“自定义 Agent Preset 的 name/description 无法随界面语言本地化”的讨论，该讨论共有 2 条评论。
